build_prompt_registry_add: build SQL prompts by calling PromptRegistry.add with context and query processors
create_add_text_chunks: create context processors using prompt_utils.add_text_chunks for corpus instructions and few-shot examples
create_add_query_turns: create query turn processors using prompt_utils.add_query_turns_with_corpus with query and corpus formats
register_sql_prompts: register few-shot SQL prompts for spider and sparc datasets across 32k, 128k, and 1m lengths
review_prompt_registry: review the PromptRegistry.add call that registers SQL prompts with context and query processors
